news.headline: Abivax ADR short interest fell 43% in October
news.summary: Short interest in the Abivax ADR fell about 43% during October, according to MarketBeat data. Bears were covering even as the stock drifted lower ahead of the year-end obefazimod NDA filing.

news.headline: Abivax shares slip back below €76 in Paris, among the weaker SBF 120 names
news.summary: Abivax's Paris listing fell back below €76.05 on November 16, extending a roughly 27% three-month decline. No company news drove the move; the stock is drifting ahead of the year-end NDA filing.

news.headline: ABIVAX at Guggenheim conference: obefazimod data lift outlook
news.summary: At the Guggenheim conference, management pitched obefazimod as a potential new standard in IBD, citing about 50% endoscopic remission at the end of maintenance in ulcerative colitis, and said it is building a 120-150 person US sales force. It reaffirmed the NDA submission by year-end 2026.

news.headline: Abivax shares rebound 2% but remain down about 30% over the quarter
news.summary: The Paris-listed shares bounced about 2% on Nov 10 (the day of the Guggenheim fireside chat) after breaking the EUR 76 support on Nov 6, but are still down roughly 30% over three months and below their moving averages.

news.headline: Piper Sandler raises Abivax price target to $175, keeps Overweight/Buy
news.summary: Piper Sandler lifted its target to $175, citing the obefazimod Phase 3 data package ahead of the planned NDA. The shares rebounded in early November after falling roughly 25-30% over the quarter.

news.headline: Abivax to Participate in Upcoming Fall Investor Conferences
news.summary: Management will appear at the Guggenheim Healthcare Innovation Conference (fireside chat Nov 10), the LifeSci Capital x Sofinnova summit in London (Nov 16), the German Equity Forum in Frankfurt (Nov 23) and Evercore ISI's healthcare conference (fireside chat Dec 2). These are the last scheduled public appearances before the year-end NDA target.

catalysts.label: German Equity Forum corporate presentation
catalysts.detail: Frankfurt, 11:40am-12:10pm CET (LifeSci Capital x Sofinnova summit in London on Nov 16 as well).

catalysts.label: Piper Sandler Healthcare Conference (Dec 1-3)
catalysts.detail: New York; the last listed investor conference on the fall tour before the year-end obefazimod UC NDA submission. Piper Sandler recently raised its target to $175.

catalysts.label: Evercore ISI Healthcare Conference fireside chat
catalysts.detail: Miami, 7:55-8:15am ET fireside chat at the Evercore ISI Healthcare Conference (Nov 30-Dec 2).

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial update
catalysts.detail: Date from Abivax's earlier 2026 financial calendar as reported; not re-confirmed in a recent release.

catalysts.label: NDA submission for obefazimod (UC)
catalysts.detail: Company-guided first NDA submission to the FDA by end of 2026, reiterated in July (pre-NDA meeting) and September (H1 results). Submission before the Mar-2027 call expiry is the key near-term event.

catalysts.label: FDA filing acceptance and PDUFA date
catalysts.detail: FDA typically decides on filing within ~60 days of submission and sets a PDUFA goal date; if submitted in December, acceptance would land around February-March 2027, close to the call's March 2027 expiry.

catalysts.label: Phase 2b topline in Crohn's disease (obefazimod)
catalysts.detail: Company-guided topline readout of the Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD trial in mid-2027; after the Mar-2027 call expiry but a key second-indication driver.

pulse: Abivax has a complete positive Phase 3 package in ulcerative colitis (induction and Week-44 maintenance), constructive pre-NDA feedback and cash into Q4 2029; management reaffirmed at Guggenheim on Nov 10 that the NDA will be filed by year-end 2026 and is building a 120-150 rep US sales force. The ADR keeps drifting lower on regulatory-timing worries and higher burn, closing about $85 on Nov 16 (down roughly 3% on the day and about 30% over three months), versus a ~$155 consensus target and ~$175 at Piper Sandler and Guggenheim. Next up are the German Equity Forum (Nov 23) and Piper Sandler/Evercore conferences (Dec 1-3), then the NDA submission and FDA filing acceptance in early 2027, the key catalysts for the Mar-2027 $120 call, which needs a roughly 40%+ rally to finish in the money.
